title: Hydrothermal Venture
description: Map hydrothermal vent lines and count points where multiple lines overlap.
writeup:
## Approach

Rasterize line segments onto a 2D grid using a `Counter` and count cells with overlap (value >= 2).

## Part 1

Only consider horizontal and vertical lines. For each segment, generate all integer points along it and count occurrences per coordinate. Points where the count reaches 2 or more are dangerous.

## Part 2

Include 45-degree diagonal lines as well. The `points_on_line` generator handles all three cases uniformly: compute the step direction as `sign(delta)` for both x and y, then iterate `max(|dx|, |dy|)` steps. This naturally covers horizontal (dy=0), vertical (dx=0), and diagonal (|dx|=|dy|) segments.
